style: Warm, whimsical children's picture-book illustration. Bold, flat digital art with clean thick outlines, brightly saturated colors, cheerful lighting. Friendly, rounded character design. Single clear scene, no text or watermarks, no panel borders.
characters: Zoe: a curious girl about 7 years old with two puffy pigtails and brown skin, wearing a yellow explorer vest and holding binoculars.
cover: Zoe standing at the edge of a colorful nature scene holding binoculars up to her eyes, with a fish jumping from water on one side and a bird flying overhead on the other, big excited smile.
pages: Zoe sitting cross-legged on green grass with a notebook and binoculars, looking curiously at little icons of a fish, a bird, a camel, and a bear floating around her like she's thinking about them.
A bright blue ocean scene with colorful fish swimming among coral, Zoe kneeling at the water's edge with binoculars watching them happily.
A sunny sky above a row of green trees, several small birds flying from one tree to another, Zoe looking up and pointing excitedly.
A sandy desert scene with dunes and a bright hot sun, a friendly camel standing calmly, Zoe watching from a safe distance shading her eyes.
A green forest full of tall trees, a friendly brown bear sitting among ferns and bushes, Zoe peeking curiously from behind a tree trunk.

Zoe standing joyfully in the center of a colorful collage-like scene with the fish, bird, camel, and bear all gathered happily around her, each near a small patch of their own habitat (water, sky, sand, forest).
